newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Alex Computer in 1-for-10 bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Alex Computer in 1-for-10 bonus issue.

text.p: South Korea's Alex Computer Co Ltd would offer a one-for-10 bonus issue in August, the Korea Stock Exchange said on Monday.
Alex will issue 240,000 common shares and distribute them to its shareholders registered as of August 8 for the bonus issue, the exchange statement said.
Alex shares closed on Monday morning at 34,500 won, up 1,500 won from Saturday's closing.
Trading of Alex shares would be suspended this afternoon due to the bonus issues and resume on Tuesday.
